opinion.headline: Sunday neurosis
opinion.hook: Many people spend their lives bound by institutions.
opinion.summary: Work expectations dominate their minds for six days. Weekends bring a sense of emptiness. This is Sunday neurosis, a term by Viktor Frankl.
